$comment: Single machine-readable source for per-agent action×resource authorization. The human-readable mirror + rationale lives in .claude/harness.config.md → 'Agent Authorization'. Flip 'mode' to 'enforce' only AFTER a warn-only trial shows the log catches ONLY real violations. See ADR-0020. Scope: RN-frontend harness (devops/backend/db roles removed — ADR-0036).

rules.reason: Reviewers are READ-ONLY — they emit findings; builders fix. No file writes, no mutating shell commands.
Builders implement to spec; specs & the task graph are architect / orchestrator / librarian territory.

The design agent owns tokens / specs / visual direction and hands implementation to frontend; it should not write application source. (warn-mode: tune for the NativeWind token files mobile/tailwind.config.js, mobile/global.css, mobile/src/theme/** during the trial — ADR-0025.)
